macros.name: linguisticsproLF
macros.doc: The default figure style is oldstyle but lining figures are available with the lf (or lining) option and locally with the \linguisticsproLF command.

macros.name: linguisticsprolgr
macros.doc: The commands \linguisticsprolgr and \linguisticsprot3 select LGR and T3-encoded type1 fonts, respectively.
